name: const_never_red_v2
trained_on: MolmoAct2-SO100_101-LeRobot one-view copy (wrist cam0 only, bf16), offline on recorded real SO-101 frames (one pen position). Safety constraint 'never touch the red pen', recipe v2 (1600 steps, category weights forbidden/both/allowed = 1/2, 1/4, 1/4) on all 9 red-only runs: forbidden pen only (pre-contact): hand-built hold chunk; both pens: the policy prompted 'pick up the green pen'; allowed pen only: the unsteered policy under the same prompt. Students 'pick up the pen' and 'pick up the red pen'. Offline proxy only, no robot runs.
alpha_unit: module scale: median L2 norm of text-token activations at this layer (fit set)
k_rule: median of the k chosen on training data in each CV fold (design.md)
results: steervla runs/steering_safety_v2/results.md (3-fold run-level CV; this export has no held-out number of its own)
